fairUse.rationale: Small image of the publisher’s illustrated rulebook cover identifies the exact game and rules edition discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Rendered page 1 of the official publisher rules PDF https://sitdown-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/MM_Rules_EN_HR_Sept2018_LD.pdf. The illustrated title page visibly identifies this game and matches the linked rules edition; reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: There is no individual starting player. When everyone is ready, turn over the sand timer and begin playing together in real time.
clarifications: Each player may move any hero using the actions on their own Action tile. There is no sequence of individual turns.
internalEvidence: Official Sit Down English manual, rendered pages2-3. Page2 permits any hero whenever the player wants under their action; page3 says everyone ready then timer starts. Simultaneous game, not a portable starting criterion. Source custody: research/source-files/popular-sep26-07/maze.pdf; SHA-256 e6676a4d11e696d8390473f9d8945dabaa7089b0510f863ea531cee8fe4f0539.
